aaa_enabled.summary: Configure centralized RADIUS or LDAP/AD servers under LDAP/RADIUS settings.
aaa_enabled.notes: Remote authentication servers must be configured in the SonicOS GUI under Device > Users > Settings > Authentication method.

secure_vty_transport.notes: Ensure HTTP administrative access is disabled globally.

vty_idle_timeout.summary: Configure web-management session inactivity timeout to 15 minutes (900 seconds) or less.
vty_idle_timeout.notes: Configure the administrative logout time parameter.

enable_secret_encrypted.summary: Ensure administrative account passwords are encrypted.
enable_secret_encrypted.notes: SonicOS local passwords are automatically hashed and encrypted in local user databases.

no_default_snmp_community.summary: Remove default SNMP community names public and private.
no_default_snmp_community.notes: Disable or delete default communities in the SonicOS GUI under Device > Setup > SNMP.

http_server_disabled.summary: Disable the HTTP web server access.

ssh_version_2.summary: Restrict management access to SSH/HTTPS on the local interfaces.
ssh_version_2.notes: Configure interface-level management parameters in the SonicOS GUI under Network > Interfaces.

logging_enabled.summary: Configure a remote syslog server target.
logging_enabled.notes: Add syslog servers in the SonicOS GUI under Device > Log > Syslog.

management_acl.summary: Configure administration rules to restrict management services to specific IP addresses.
management_acl.notes: Go to SonicOS GUI > Device > Administration > Web Management to add network restrictions.

password_min_length.summary: Enforce local user password complexity requirements.
password_min_length.notes: Configure minimum password length and complexity under Device > Users > Settings.

ntp_configured.notes: Add NTP servers and enable time synchronization in the SonicOS GUI under Device > Time.

no_write_snmp_community.summary: Configure SNMP communities to read-only access only.
no_write_snmp_community.notes: Verify SNMP community access rights under Device > Setup > SNMP.
